source.author: verg
source.text: Nec non et pulcher Iulus, ante annos animumque gerens curamque virilem, multa patri mandata dabat portanda: sed aurae omnia discerpunt et nubibus irrita donant.
source.text_original: Nec non et pulcher Iulus, / ante annos animumque gerens curamque virilem, / multa patri mandata dabat portanda: sed aurae / omnia discerpunt et nubibus irrita donant.
source.text_english: And so too the fair Iulus, though still young in years and bearing a manly spirit and concern, was giving many messages to be carried to his father; but the winds scatter them all and give them vainly to the clouds.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tu, cui iam curaeque vigent animique viriles, i, decus, et pecoris Nephelaei vellera Graio redde tholo ac tantis temet dignare periclis.
reuse.text_original: tu, cui iam curaeque vigent animique viriles, / i, decus, et pecoris Nephelaei vellera Graio / redde tholo ac tantis temet dignare periclis.
reuse.text_english: You, in whom now both cares and manly courage are strong, go, my glory, and restore to the Greek shrine the fleece of the Nephelaean flock, and deem yourself worthy of so great dangers.
